children: MIRA Pharmaceuticals announced positive 7-day dose-range toxicology and toxicokinetic results for MIRA-55, informing dose selection and supporting a targeted Q1 2027 IND submission.
Completed 7-day rat and dog studies showed tolerability and systemic exposure to guide dose selection for next IND-enabling phase.
Rats were the more sensitive species; dogs showed greater tolerance across studied dose levels, aiding cross-species dosing decisions.
Findings will inform design of subsequent GLP toxicology studies and support ongoing IND-enabling program activities.
Company advanced manufacturing scale-up and formulation work in parallel to prepare for clinical development.
Subject to completion of remaining studies and regulatory requirements, the company is targeting an IND submission in Q1 2027.
